name: RTK
summary: A CLI and hook that route shell commands through filters to shorten their output. Rejected on negative evidence: about 7.6% more cost at low effort and no difference at high (JetBrains), 13% higher total cost (Dasein, sponsor-run). The hook skips the PowerShell tool and sits in the permission path. engine/ and proxy/ are BUSL-1.1; the optional rtk-proxy would sit in the request path.

evidence.source: https://blog.jetbrains.com/ai/2026/07/rtk-claude-code-token-savings/ (rtk Claude Code Token Savings: A Skill Trial Benchmark)
evidence.effect: Cost +7.6% at low effort (p = 0.004), no change at high effort

evidence.setting: Sponsor-run benchmark; the ledger lists it under E1 for RTK

evidence.source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22732 (TokenEconomizer: Experience-Driven Black-Box Cost Control for Coding Agents)
evidence.setting: RTK reference arm in TokenEconomizer's vendor-run baseline; figures from its tables per the research notes, not re-read

evidence.source: https://github.com/rtk-ai/rtk/issues/1319 (Add Claude Code PowerShell hook compatibility)
evidence.effect: The hook doesn't cover the PowerShell tool

evidence.source: https://github.com/rtk-ai/rtk/issues/3673 (An allow rule that names arguments is matched as a prefix, granting more than it says)
evidence.effect: Allow rules naming arguments match as prefixes

evidence.source: https://github.com/rtk-ai/rtk/issues/3970 (Permission verdict is computed on a command that is not the one that runs)
evidence.effect: The permission verdict is computed on a different command from the one that runs
Apache-2.0 at the root; BUSL-1.1 in engine/ and proxy/; the BUSL use grant wasn't reviewed

egress.optional: the optional rtk-proxy (BUSL-1.1) would put requests through a proxy

revisit: an independent paired test with at least 5% lower cost per accepted task at non-inferior quality, including the PowerShell tool
maintenance: Third-party tool with frequent releases (v1.1.0 on 2026-10-25).
